bias.en: Downtrend · broke $317, MACD and SAR turned down
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $317，MACD 与 SAR 同步转空

read.en: Applied Materials fell 10.7% on Nov 20 to $302.63, its lowest close since Feb 4, trading $300.62–330.50 on heavy volume (1.73x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($338.7), 10-day ($358.3), 30-day ($386.7) and 100-day ($471.3), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($447.2). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish the same day ($404.71), and RSI is 30.8.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月20日下跌 10.7%，收于 $302.63，为 2月4日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $300.62–330.50，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.73 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$338.7）、10 日（$358.3）、30 日（$386.7）和 100 日均线（$471.3）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$447.2）。MACD 于 11月20日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 同日转为看空（$404.71），RSI 为 30.8。

read.en: The close broke all three written supports, $316.95–332.7 (Nov 5 low, Nov 6 low and close), now resistance. Resistance is $311–317 (Jan 23, Mar 9 and Nov 5 lows), then $329–332.7 and $338–339 (5-day, Nov 19 close). Support is $300 (Nov 20 low), then $287.5 (Feb 4 low) and $276. A close above $317 would target $329–332.7; below $300, $287.5.
